card.name: Nouns ending a medical phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a short clinical phrase in drug labels, such as medication, observation, duration, overdose, or the in area under the curve. It often comes right before a comma, a preposition, or a new clause.

modes.label: Phrase-final noun
modes.description: A noun that completes a phrase about drug use, study timing, or exposure.

modes.description: The word the within the pharmacokinetic phrase area under the curve.
modes.example: significant increase in area under<< the>> curve (50%)
